clips.title: The story
paras: Prompt Potion Runner is an urgent Undercity delivery quest where players must race an unstable concoction across the slime canal to the Apothecarium. The quest highlights the physical infirmities of undeath and the volatile nature of Forsaken alchemical research.

In the subterranean corridors of the Undercity, the Forsaken alchemist Alessandro urgently needs a swift courier. Having prepared a highly volatile concoction with an extremely short shelf life, he cannot risk transporting it himself across the city's toxic slime canal due to the fragile state of his undead joints. An adventurer must sprint against the clock to ensure the brew arrives intact before it degrades into useless sludge.

The destination is the Apothecarium, where Doctor Martin Felben eagerly awaits the delivery for his ongoing research. Felben reveals that the previous six couriers or attempts failed because the potions destabilized mid-transit. A timely arrival allows the doctor to continue his shadowy experiments uninterrupted, underscoring both the volatility of Royal Apothecary concoctions and the physical indignities of undeath.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!
It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.
Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.
But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!
Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?
If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
